title: AUTH ME TIMEOUT OPTIMIZATION
goal: /auth/me is a lightweight session existence and basic user identity endpoint.

before.session_validation: validate_session() loaded auth_session, loaded user, updated last_seen_at, and committed.
before.permission_resolution: resolve_current_user_permission_info() resolved effective permission assignments for /auth/me.
risk: Multiple DB operations on a login-critical read path.
Permission aggregation could block auth hydration.
Read requests wrote auth_sessions.last_seen_at and amplified DB pool pressure.

after.middleware_short_circuit: short_circuit_auth_me returns the minimal response before the heavy middleware chain.

pytest_target_files.reason: Default DATABASE_URL points to host 'db', which is not resolvable in this workspace.

testclient_sqlite_smoke.reason: Minimal TestClient script did not return within 60 seconds in this workspace; service-level DB verification passed.

success_criteria_mapping.auth_me_under_200ms: code path reduced to cache hit or one indexed SELECT; live latency not measurable in current workspace
success_criteria_mapping.no_middleware_chain_blocking: short-circuit middleware and explicit middleware bypasses implemented
success_criteria_mapping.login_no_longer_stuck_on_loading: /auth/me no longer resolves permissions or commits read-path writes
